paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Depth
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Prompt Depth and Accuracy, comparing two models, mmsd and mmsd2. The x-axis represents Prompt Depth in units of J, with a linear scale ranging from 1 to 11, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents Accuracy as a percentage, with a linear scale from 74 to 81, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The orange dashed line with square markers represents the mmsd model, starting at approximately 80% accuracy at a Prompt Depth of 1, remaining relatively stable until a Prompt Depth of 7, then increasing to a peak of around 81.2% at a Prompt Depth of 9, before decreasing to about 80.2% at a Prompt Depth of 11. The blue solid line with circular markers represents the mmsd2 model, beginning at roughly 76.5% accuracy at a Prompt Depth of 1, decreasing to around 74% at a Prompt Depth of 3, then rising to approximately 77.5% at a Prompt Depth of 7 and 9, before declining to about 76.8% at a Prompt Depth of 11.
